units: <cite ref="Chullin 46a:11">Ḥull. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>די׳ זה וכ׳</he> as to this case of (<he>נדלדלה</he>) the liver found to be torn &c.

senses.gloss: wart with a thin neck, v. יַבֶּלֶת. Pl. דִּלְדּוּלִין, דִּי׳.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 6:7">Neg. VI, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 2:2">Tosef. ib. II, 2</cite> <he>תלתלין</he>); Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. 1, ch. II.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:6">Bekh. VII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Bekhorot 45b:5">45ᵇ</cite>, Rashi <he>תלתולין</he>) <he>בעלי הד׳</he> persons or animals afflicted with large warts.
Neg. VI, 8 הד׳ שבראש וכ׳ (hairless) warts on the head or chin (Tos’f. Yom Tob: isolated hair-grown spots).
